evidence.title: Announcing the winners of the 2022 Foundational Integrity Research request for proposals

summary: The funding agency has released the list of projects selected under the 2022 Foundational Integrity Research request for proposals, awarding grants to several teams focused on AI safety and integrity. The awarded research will explore methods to ensure trustworthy, reliable, and robust artificial intelligence systems.
title: 2022 Foundational Integrity Research RFP Winners Announced
